Fast & Simple Process

How to Get Your
SIA Licence

A simple 6-step journey from booking your training to starting your career as a fully licensed security professional.

01

Book Training

Browse available training courses and book your preferred date and location to start your licence journey.

02

Attend Course

Attend professional training sessions delivered by experienced instructors at trusted learning locations.

03

Pass Assessment

Successfully complete your course assessment to demonstrate your knowledge and practical skills.

04

Receive Certificate

Receive your accredited training certificate confirming you have completed the required qualification.

05

Apply for SIA Licence

Use your training certificate to apply for your SIA licence through the official SIA website.

06

Start Working

Once your SIA licence is approved, you're ready to begin your career in the security industry.
